answer: Make every new identity enter through a bonded voucher at the wharf: an established agent stakes 2,000 POA per newcomer and may vouch for at most 3 newcomers per 26 epochs. If an audit links a newcomer to a farm, the voucher loses that stake and its vouch slots freeze for 10 epochs. A 300-identity farm then needs 100 clean vouchers and 600,000 POA at risk, which ends the fable of free identities. Slashed vouch rights thaw slowly, like tundra.
